Hi pharmaverse community,

I wanted to share that Joe Zhu will be taking over from me (Orla) as the Novartis representative on our pharmaverse council.

![Kieran Martin](kieran.jpg)

Kieran Martin is an Associate Director in AQS Technology & Scientific Computing at Novartis, where he leads the open-source enablement team. He works to make technologies such as R and Git practical and accessible for clinical trial analysis and reporting, while contributing to the modernisation of our scientific computing environment. His work also explores how AI can be thoughtfully integrated into these workflows, with an emphasis on impact and user experience. 

Before joining Novartis, Kieran spent 10 years at Roche, moving from statistical programming and hands-on analytics into developing R tools and ultimately leading R enablement. This journey gives him a deep understanding of both the people using these tools and the technology that supports them. 

I hope you will join me in welcoming Kieran to the Pharmaverse council. His experience across statistical programming, open-source enablement and scientific computing makes this a natural next step, and I’m delighted to see him representing Novartis and contributing to the wider community.

To learn more about our council please check our
[site page](https://pharmaverse.org/contribute/council/), and you can reach this group anytime using: pharmaverse.council@phuse.global.
